summary: Ansible 12 community.postgresql deprecations: the port alias (use login_port), the login, unix_socket and host aliases (use login_user, login_unix_socket and login_host), the db and database aliases (use login_db) in many modules, and postgresql_db state=rename.
questions: What replaces the port alias in postgresql modules?
Should I use login_host instead of host?

answer_card.title: community.postgresql: renamed connection options
answer_card.answer_md:
Use the `login_*` names; these aliases will be removed in community.postgresql 5.0.0:

| Deprecated alias | Use |
|---|---|
| `port` | `login_port` |
| `login` | `login_user` |
| `unix_socket` | `login_unix_socket` |
| `host` | `login_host` |
| `db`, `database` | `login_db` |
